global: Long-form explainer (what if your DNA vanished). Off-white canvas, black line art, red reserved for scribbles, circles, Xs and warning labels; grey for faded/secondary elements and gamma rays. Opening presenter-and-whiteboard with question card; series title card; then a sequence of diagram scenes (scale figure with grey DNA, cell diagrams, three-column causes, mushroom/forest, a recurring spiral diary, hospital X-ray, doxorubicin cell-division row, IS THIS CELL DIVIDING? scatter chart, nuclear blast with gamma rays, castle-wall immune system, flowchart) and a two-officer punchline; red end card.

states.VS012: Same figure on scale; DNA helix now light grey (faded over 6 f, G0022).
states.VS036: Single stick figure standing centre on blank canvas (end of the 16-f zoom-out from the cell; the cell is now a speck inside the head).
states.VS040: Hospital: masked surgeon left, gurney with patient and IV right, X-ray of torso with a taped-on card showing a clean liver over the old scribbled liver; kidney scribbles remain.
states.VS073: Castle wall: tower HOMEOSTASIS, long wall IMMUNE SYSTEM with spear-holding cell guards on the battlements; outside right: virus, phage, coccus chain, bacterium.
states.VS074: Same framing as VS073 (no camera move; hold shift <=3 px): grey wavy Y-RAY lines strike the wall; wall top broken, guards falling, rubble.
states.VS090: Red end card: original transfer must use an original series card (mascot left, books + call-out centre, credits right).

motion: Mostly 1-frame pops/swaps (poses, labels, objects, red scribbles, circles, Xs) on a static camera; staggered per-frame label write-ons (chart dot-labels f2811-2816, HAIR FOLLICLE/BONE MARROW/STOMACH f2870-2876, grey DNA squiggles into circles f3040-3045, flowchart branch f4146-4148, red Xs f1110-1113); a 6-f grey-out fade of the DNA (f345-350); one 16-f continuous zoom-out with motion blur (f1742-1757: cell shrinks to a speck, a giant blurred figure whose head contains the speck shrinks into frame and sharpens by f1756). Series title card f281-328 animates only the mascot; 21 shot cuts plus a hidden cut f328|f329 inside G0020.
continuity: The DNA helix is the recurring hero object (black -> grey -> red-scribbled -> broken blob); the diary recurs four times with the same layout and day tabs, entries rewritten per scenario (mushrooms / DNA accident / nuclear picnic) and the TUESDAY 'feeling fine!' circled in red; the cell diagram (DNA -> PROTEINS, AMATOXIN, SYNTAX ERROR) recurs in the desk scene; the three cause columns recur with the finished column greyed. Replace the series mascot, title card and end card with original designs.
